unavailable_fields.per_collective_wire_time_ms: No available collector separates NCCL device waiting from wire transfer; kernel durations in the objective metric include waiting (workloads communication_metric_caveat), and nsys timelines cannot split waiting from transfer.
unavailable_fields.per_collective_pcie_bytes: device_telemetry yields device-wide NVML rate samples in native windows, not per-collective bytes; hardware byte counters remain unprobed; PCIe/NVLink traffic must not be inferred from logical payload (28351488/157541376 B) or memcpy sizes.
unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: NVLink is unsupported on both leased GPUs (nvmlDeviceGetNvLinkState returned NVML status 3, no links; peer_access.0.1 and peer_access.1.0 observed 0.0), so allreduce traffic rides PCIe and no NVLink counters exist.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_bounds: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for matched CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown.
unavailable_fields.critical_path_lower_bound_ms: collective_calibration is a correctness-checked reference experiment at observed sizes/dtypes, not a performance lower bound or critical-path estimate; no available collector supplies one.

plan.rationale: Target revision faadcab8e6aa66525c8cb171d3a9ed1da9b315a8b5874d3d2cc7cbd41da766a5 is the only listed candidate; its clean projection failed the step_ms constraint (256.978 vs limit 138.660; original reference 132.057) while communication_kernel_sum_ms stayed nearly flat (rank0 74.676->62.080, rank1 64.149->63.542), so ~125 ms of non-NCCL-kernel time appeared and its source is unattributed. binding_cost is applicable (candidate exists, bundle trial-b04d1d014e-param-cab8b6e9 bound legacy at 2 functional sites with reference still invoked 13x, not a parent replacement) and gives a clean AB/BA parent-vs-binding-passthrough bound on the binding share of that regression; python_runtime adds warmed function-level host dispatch/binding attribution (perturbing, inclusive/self times are not scores); execution_timeline contributes CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization and per-device intervals and corroborates the candidate-declared routes (b8ade439... armed_after_first_burst, d0938de8... observing_first_burst), which the evaluation flags as candidate-reported telemetry needing trace corroboration, with 13 reference invocations of unclear fallback/verification/composition role; nsys is available (request.json tools.nsys) and is selected for the overlap/attribution questions - where the +125 ms sits, whether the 13 allreduces (12x 28351488 B + 1x 157541376 B f32 SUM, world 2) are serialized with or hidden behind backward compute, and native corroboration of route labels - while acknowledging it cannot split NCCL waiting from wire transfer or prove bucket identity (bucket identity is already resolved via observed gradient-storage membership plus matched parameter inventory for all 13 collectives). For the communication objective itself, nccl_tuning captures the actual NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel decisions in a warmed worker at these sizes over PCIe (NVLink unsupported, peer access off), since the observed RING_LL kernel entry names alone do not identify the protocol and protocol/channel choice is the main non-structural lever on kernel-duration sum; collective_calibration runs the correctness-checked synthetic full-world SUM allreduce at the observed sizes/dtypes as a reference for interpreting the in-step durations (rank0 ~3.25 ms vs rank1 ~14.3 ms per 28 MB bucket indicates large arrival-skew waiting inside the metric), used strictly as reference, not as a lower bound. torch is excluded because it already ran and supplied the objective field; device_telemetry is excluded because its device-wide NVML windows cannot be attributed to the 13 collectives and would not change the attribution; candidate_diagnostics adds no capability beyond the trace corroboration above.

usage.scope: Observed assistant message snapshots; provider estimates, not invoice
